vul_data.function:
1. Retrieve the group descriptor for the specified block group.  
2. Get the buffer corresponding to the block bitmap.  
3. Check if the block bitmap is up-to-date; if so, proceed to verification.  
4. Lock the buffer and handle the initialization of the block bitmap if it is uninitialized.  
5. Unlock the group and buffer after handling the initialization.  
6. Submit the buffer for reading if it is not up-to-date.  
7. Validate the block bitmap after it has been read or initialized.  
8. Handle errors and clean up resources before returning an error pointer if necessary.  
9. Return the buffer head of the block bitmap if successful.
